request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and storytelling tone, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, gentle mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
These are the kings who reigned in the land
Before any king reigned over the Israelites
Bela son of Beor became king in Edom
His city was named Dinhabah

[Chorus]
The first king in the land of Edom
Bela son of Beor ruled there
Before kings came to rule the tribes
His story is written in the books

[Verse]
Esau is Edom in the hill country of Seir
He took his wives and moved away from Jacob
Their possessions were too great to live together
So the lineage of kings began to grow

[Chorus]
The first king in the land of Edom
Bela son of Beor ruled there
Before kings came to rule the tribes
His story is written in the books

[Bridge]
When Bela died Jobab son of Zerah succeeded him
From Bozrah he reigned in his place
The list in Chronicles confirms the name
Of the first king of the Edomites

[Chorus]
The first king in the land of Edom
Bela son of Beor ruled there
Before kings came to rule the tribes
His story is written in the books

[Outro]
Bela son of Beor
King of Dinhabah
